maddeler.e:
تستحبون (form X)
# تَسْتَحِبُّونَ (tastaḥibbūna) /tas.ta.ħib.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
# تُسْتَحَبُّونَ (tustaḥabbūna) /tus.ta.ħab.buː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَحَبَّ (istaḥabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
